Verified macOS wxWidgets3.2.12 WKWebView backend only. Experimental Linux GTK3 WebKitGTK is opt-in and unverified on Linux (wx3.2.12, matching WebKitGTK ABI); Windows remains unavailable; a hash-pinned cancellation prerequisite patch is provided but not native-verified or integrated as a Windows backend. See docs/WEB-VIEW-PORTABILITY.md. Active GUI thread/session and live WEB-VIEW WINDOW container; private browser child has no public handle. JavaScript enabled for trusted development content, not a security sandbox. Known wx native dialogs/upload/popups/printing suppressed, known permission requests denied; no complete OS WebKit security/permission policy claim. Mutations/scripts reject callbacks and protect receiver/ancestors/native reentry; use deferred actions. No managed handler stacks, native backend adoption, owned/synthetic/cloned web events. See docs/WEB-VIEW.md. Queued immutable command snapshots: :web-message text is JSON (including quoted strings); :web-script-result text is JSON on success or an error description on failure, EVENT-INTEGER is1/0 and EVENT-EXTRA-LONG is the request ticket; :web-loaded text is native URL and :web-error text is native error description. BIND-EVENT supports scoped contexts/Skip/propagation but payload SETF rejects. Async delivery occurs through normal GUI polling/RUN, never directly from an Objective-C completion. Native loaded/error events can reflect prior/subframe navigation; no exact per-navigation correlation or veto API. JavaScript evaluation uses internal WKWebView evaluateJavaScript on macOS and native GIO evaluation on experimental Linux, not wxWebView::RunScriptAsync/clientData ownership. Native per-navigation veto/history-resource APIs remain unbound. Explicit URL navigation/base-URL inputs support about:blank or absolute http/https/file URLs only; native links, redirects and subresource loads are not a complete navigation sandbox. JSON script messages can originate from all frames and origins; receipt does not authenticate the sender or authorize an action.

Active main-thread GUI session and checked native lifetimes. All AUI writes reject callbacks; structural edits require quiescence or owner-bound deferred action. Canonical PANEL roots precede publication; remove retains hidden same-parent child, delete invalidates by native destruction. Full native tab-event spans protect book/pages/ancestors and block nested GUI/modal/clipboard entry. Top tabs with native programmatic Split, same-notebook existing-group mouse movement and active close; external transfer, mouse drag splitting, icons/art providers and managed handler-stack access remain unbound. Requires wxUSE_AUI and aui component. See docs/AUI-NOTEBOOK.md. Programmatic SPLIT-NOTEBOOK-PAGE preserves page parents and global catalogue identities; native selection may notify/veto after group structure commits. ABI72 replaces group-local/global-index-unsafe native drag paths with checked page-identity movement within and between existing groups; empty sources retire safely and drag hints/cursors clear on drop/cancel. All mutations also reject an active native tab gesture/capture. Pinned3.2.12 has501 private tab-group ID allocations per book lifetime; split or empty-book insertion refuses exhaustion before creating unusable native tabs. Private group-local PAGE_CHANGING callbacks are filtered; public EVENT-SELECTION uses native global catalogue indices, while old-selection keeps native semantics (CLOSE can be group-local). Application extension: native-only TAB_RIGHT_UP supplies clicked-tab identity for deferred context menus. ABI72 adds visual notebook-group-pages and checked move-notebook-page-to-group. Native selection transactions suppress only incidental CHILD_FOCUS reentry, retaining public notifications/veto.

declarations.declaration: virtual void Split(size_t page, int direction);
declarations.scope: Active main-thread GUI session and checked native lifetimes. All AUI writes reject callbacks; structural edits require quiescence or owner-bound deferred action. Canonical PANEL roots precede publication; remove retains hidden same-parent child, delete invalidates by native destruction. Full native tab-event spans protect book/pages/ancestors and block nested GUI/modal/clipboard entry. Top tabs with native programmatic Split, same-notebook existing-group mouse movement and active close; external transfer, mouse drag splitting, icons/art providers and managed handler-stack access remain unbound. Requires wxUSE_AUI and aui component. See docs/AUI-NOTEBOOK.md. Programmatic SPLIT-NOTEBOOK-PAGE preserves page parents and global catalogue identities; native selection may notify/veto after group structure commits. ABI72 replaces group-local/global-index-unsafe native drag paths with checked page-identity movement within and between existing groups; empty sources retire safely and drag hints/cursors clear on drop/cancel. All mutations also reject an active native tab gesture/capture. wxFrame.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Title, width and height; parent is NULL, ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open. Frame-only synchronous close requests now preserve veto/force semantics and native acceptance; no destruction guarantee.

wxPanel.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent only; remaining constructor options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open. DRAWING-CANVAS additionally uses a private retained wxPanel subclass with WINDOW Lisp ancestry and copied bounded rendering data; it does not widen general PANEL methods. Private retained drawing/value adapter via DRAWING-CANVAS/CANVAS-CONTENT and SAVE-CANVAS-IMAGE only. Bounded scene: opaque RGB bytes, signed DIP geometry, Swiss/sans point-size text and copied RGB bitmap buffers; private native DC/font/colour/image/bitmap resources never escape or become Lisp objects. Callback writes/export defer; source/ancestor/native-entry guards and staged scene replacement. Native paint exceptions are contained; PNG output uses private handler and checked non-atomic file write. No standalone class/API parity. See docs/DRAWING-CANVAS.md. WEB-VIEW additionally uses a private wxPanel container with WINDOW Lisp ancestry around a privately owned wxWebView child. This grants the container supported generic WINDOW layout/state/lifetime behavior, not arbitrary PANEL/browser-child API or raw ownership. Native browser/backend/JS delegate resources remain private; managed handler-stack access rejects. Verified macOS3.2.12 WKWebView only; see docs/WEB-VIEW.md. ABI60 adds copied RGBA scene pixels with native alpha composition; same1..256 extent and2MiB aggregate cap.

wxButton.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent and label; ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxTextCtrl.scope: Native-backed CLOS parent/value construction with boolean multiline and initial user-editability styles. Explicit UTF-8 lengths/NUL rejection; mutable generic user editability, bounded native selection/insertion/end and notifying Replace. Fixed ID/default geometry; other styles, GetRange, undo/redo, rich text and full class parity remain unbound.

wxStaticText.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent and label; ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxCheckBox.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent, label and initial boolean value; two-state control, ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxChoice.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent, copied strings and initial selection; wxArrayString overload, ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxBoxSizer.scope: Parent-owned horizontal/vertical layout only; standalone sizers and full API remain open.

wxWindow.scope: Logical names, visibility and effective enabled state, layout, geometry and destruction are exposed; the remaining wxWindow API stays open. Managed handler stacks and explicit stack-aware copied routing are now supported. Push preserves bridge ownership; default pop/remove detach alive, deleting pop consumes native resource. All supported concrete native window destructors (including supported generic dialogs) pop(false) before base teardown, independent of destroy observers/enabled flags. No external adoption/SetEventHandler or retained origins. Modal-only dialog show writers reject; active modal/ancestor close/destroy guards preserve native modal lifetime. Native availability rejects pending/scheduled receiver or ancestor deletion through public wxApp::IsScheduledForDestruction plus bridge markers; no dedicated general deletion-query API. ABI43 safe deferred UI actions are explicit structural boundaries under RUN/poll; normal callback/modal guards and no nested RUN/pumps/finish remain. See docs/DEFERRED-UI-ACTIONS.md. DRAWING-CANVAS and ACTIVITY-INDICATOR are WINDOW receivers for implemented generic layout/geometry/state/lifetime/handler protocols; this is not arbitrary wxPanel/wxControl parity. Canvas writes/export and activity writes retain their callback/native-operation guards. GRID and WEB-VIEW are concrete WINDOW receivers for the implemented generic layout, geometry, visibility, enabled state and lifetime operations. Their private composite scroll/browser event handling forbids managed handler-stack access/edits; their own mutation and callback guards remain in force. AUI-NOTEBOOK inherits supported generic WINDOW geometry/state/lifetime behavior; private manager handler stacks and own page layouts reject. Active main-thread GUI session and checked native lifetimes. All AUI writes reject callbacks; structural edits require quiescence or owner-bound deferred action. Canonical PANEL roots precede publication; remove retains hidden same-parent child, delete invalidates by native destruction. Full native tab-event spans protect book/pages/ancestors and block nested GUI/modal/clipboard entry. Top tabs with native programmatic Split, same-notebook existing-group mouse movement and active close; external transfer, mouse drag splitting, icons/art providers and managed handler-stack access remain unbound. Requires wxUSE_AUI and aui component. See docs/AUI-NOTEBOOK.md. STYLED-TEXT-CONTROL and AUI-NOTEBOOK inherit supported generic WINDOW geometry/state/lifetime operations. AUI manager handler stacks/page layout remain private; raw input and STC/AUI callbacks retain actual-source/composite/ancestor native-entry guards. wxWebView.scope: Verified macOS wxWidgets3.2.12 WKWebView backend only. Experimental Linux GTK3 WebKitGTK is opt-in and unverified on Linux (wx3.2.12, matching WebKitGTK ABI); Windows remains unavailable; a hash-pinned cancellation prerequisite patch is provided but not native-verified or integrated as a Windows backend. See docs/WEB-VIEW-PORTABILITY.md. Active GUI thread/session and live WEB-VIEW WINDOW container; private browser child has no public handle. JavaScript enabled for trusted development content, not a security sandbox. Known wx native dialogs/upload/popups/printing suppressed, known permission requests denied; no complete OS WebKit security/permission policy claim. Mutations/scripts reject callbacks and protect receiver/ancestors/native reentry; use deferred actions. No managed handler stacks, native backend adoption, owned/synthetic/cloned web events. See docs/WEB-VIEW.md. Queued immutable command snapshots: :web-message text is JSON (including quoted strings); :web-script-result text is JSON on success or an error description on failure, EVENT-INTEGER is1/0 and EVENT-EXTRA-LONG is the request ticket; :web-loaded text is native URL and :web-error text is native error description. BIND-EVENT supports scoped contexts/Skip/propagation but payload SETF rejects. Async delivery occurs through normal GUI polling/RUN, never directly from an Objective-C completion. Native loaded/error events can reflect prior/subframe navigation; no exact per-navigation correlation or veto API. JavaScript evaluation uses internal WKWebView evaluateJavaScript on macOS and native GIO evaluation on experimental Linux, not wxWebView::RunScriptAsync/clientData ownership. Native per-navigation veto/history-resource APIs remain unbound. Explicit URL navigation/base-URL inputs support about:blank or absolute http/https/file URLs only; native links, redirects and subresource loads are not a complete navigation sandbox. JSON script messages can originate from all frames and origins; receipt does not authenticate the sender or authorize an action. Experimental GTK construction rejects native stacks outside pthread bounds before JavaScriptCore entry; this is crash containment for alternate-stack Lisp runtimes, not Linux browser acceptance.

wxAuiNotebook.scope: Active main-thread GUI session and checked native lifetimes. All AUI writes reject callbacks; structural edits require quiescence or owner-bound deferred action. Requires wxUSE_AUI and aui component. See docs/AUI-NOTEBOOK.md. Programmatic SPLIT-NOTEBOOK-PAGE preserves page parents and global catalogue identities; native selection may notify/veto after group structure commits. ABI72 replaces group-local/global-index-unsafe native drag paths with checked page-identity movement within and between existing groups; empty sources retire safely and drag hints/cursors clear on drop/cancel. All mutations also reject an active native tab gesture/capture. Pinned3.2.12 has501 private tab-group ID allocations per book lifetime; split or empty-book insertion refuses exhaustion before creating unusable native tabs. Private group-local PAGE_CHANGING callbacks are filtered; public EVENT-SELECTION uses native global catalogue indices, while old-selection keeps native semantics (CLOSE can be group-local). Application extension: native-only TAB_RIGHT_UP supplies clicked-tab identity for deferred context menus. ABI72 adds visual notebook-group-pages and checked move-notebook-page-to-group. Native selection transactions suppress only incidental CHILD_FOCUS reentry, retaining public notifications/veto.
